<summary>Prompt for LLM</summary>

````text
Fix PR description omits the required issue reference

The PR title starts with `fix(`, so this is a user-facing fix and the check applies. The description contains no GitHub closing statement (`Closes/Fixes/Resolves #123`, case-insensitive) and no issue mention at all (`#123` or `owner/repo#123`). Fix PRs must reference a tracked issue or feature request so the confirmed observation and the issue-design decision behind the fix are traceable. Add the closing statement for the issue this fix addresses, e.g. `Closes #1234`, to the PR description.

Kody rule violation: [Ensure feat/fix PRs close referenced issues](https://app.kodus.io/settings/code-review/global/kody-rules/18153886-f5a5-45bd-a3a3-c287086a5cf5?teamId=ebb24108-be7e-4fd9-9346-f1f2c7c0b7f1)
````
